system.description:
Represents a character's access to useful but non-powerful equipment suitable for the campaign setting.
Level 1: A couple pieces of Gear (1-2)
Level 2: A few pieces of Gear (3-5)
Level 3: Several pieces of Gear (6-10)
Level 4: Many pieces of Gear (11-25)
Level 5: Large amount of Gear (26-50)
Level 6: Huge amount of Gear (51-100)
